parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is a faucet switch made of brass, typically used to control water flow. It is small and ergonomically shaped for hand operation.
parts.Functional_description: It controls the water flow and temperature by rotating or turning the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axis to open or close the water valve.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is another faucet switch made of brass, similar to the first one, used for controlling either hot or cold water.
parts.Functional_description: It regulates the water flow and temperature by turning the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axis to adjust the water flow.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is a frame part of the faucet made of brass, providing structural support for the spout and switches.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the spout and switches in place and connects them to the plumbing system.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: This is the spout of the faucet made of brass, through which water flows out.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the water flow from the faucet to the sink.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel slightly depending on the faucet design, but generally remains fixed.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is a frame section of the faucet made of brass, supporting the spout connection.
parts.Functional_description: It provides mechanical stability and connects the spout to the base.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is another frame part of the faucet made of brass, forming the base of one of the switches.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the switch and connects it to the internal valve system.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides a stable base for the switch.
